claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Talniflumate is a poorly soluble fenamate prodrug with no potent cytotoxic target at 2.5 uM; any killing is likely weak and non-selective, possibly from cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or nonspecific membrane effects rather than COX/CLCA1 inhibition.
